hero.title: Frontend engineering, with the busywork automated away.
hero.description: I design and build production interfaces in React and Next.js — then wire AI automation straight into the workflow itself, from content generation to lead triage.

howIWork.title: How I work
howIWork.description: Four things I hold to on every build, from a single component to a full product.

performance.title: 01 — Performance first
performance.text: Loading, rendering and JS load handled as part of the build, not an afterthought.

clean.title: 02 — Clean & maintainable
clean.text: Reusable components, typed end-to-end with Zod and TypeScript.

ai.title: 03 — AI-assisted workflow
ai.text: AI accelerates the build and automates repetitive parts — every output reviewed before it ships.

responsive.title: 04 — Responsive by default
responsive.text: Designed and tested across desktop, tablet and mobile, not just the screenshot breakpoint.

services.title: Freelance services
services.description: I take on a small number of freelance engagements alongside my own projects.

frontend.title: Frontend Development
frontend.text: Building responsive, modern web interfaces with React and Next.js, from a single component to a full application.

landing.title: Landing Pages
landing.text: High-clarity, fast-loading landing pages designed to communicate a product or offer clearly and convert visitors.

dashboards.title: Dashboard Interfaces
dashboards.text: Modern admin and data-management dashboards with sensible information hierarchy, tables, and filtering.
